text: The monthly rent is $1,200, payable on the first day of each month.
Rent shall be paid by bank transfer to the account designated by the Landlord.
The Landlord may increase the rent at any time at its sole discretion.
Rent will remain fixed for the full twelve-month term of this agreement.
The Landlord may raise the rent without notice if property taxes increase.
Any rent increase requires at least sixty days written notice to the Tenant.
Tenant agrees to pay twelve months of rent in advance, which is non-refundable.
Rent for a partial month will be prorated on a daily basis.
The Tenant shall pay a security deposit equal to one month's rent.
The security deposit is non-refundable under all circumstances.
The deposit will be returned within 30 days after the Tenant moves out, minus documented damages.
The Landlord will provide an itemized list of any deductions from the deposit.
The Tenant forfeits the entire deposit if the lease is ended early for any reason.
Normal wear and tear will not be deducted from the security deposit.
The Landlord may keep the deposit to cover cleaning costs regardless of the condition of the unit.
The deposit will be held in a separate account and will not be used as last month's rent.
The Landlord may enter the premises at any time without notice.
The Landlord will give at least 24 hours written notice before entering the unit, except in emergencies.
The Landlord or its agents may access the apartment at any time for any purpose.
Entry for repairs will take place during normal business hours with advance notice.
The Tenant may not change the locks, and the Landlord keeps a key and may enter without prior notice.
In an emergency such as fire or flooding, the Landlord may enter without prior notice.
Showings to prospective tenants will be scheduled with the Tenant in advance.
The Landlord may inspect the unit whenever it chooses, and the Tenant waives any right to privacy.
The Landlord is responsible for repairs to plumbing, heating, and electrical systems.
The Tenant is responsible for all repairs, including structural repairs and the roof.
The Tenant shall report any damage or needed repairs to the Landlord promptly.
The Tenant must pay for any repairs, regardless of the cause of the damage.
The Landlord will make necessary repairs within a reasonable time after being notified.
The Tenant accepts the unit as-is and the Landlord has no obligation to make any repairs.
The Tenant will pay for damage caused by the Tenant's own negligence or guests.
Minor maintenance such as replacing light bulbs is the Tenant's responsibility.
Either party may end this lease by giving sixty days written notice.
The Landlord may terminate this lease and require the Tenant to vacate within 3 days for any reason.
This lease will automatically renew for another full year unless cancelled 90 days before the end date.
At the end of the term, the lease converts to a month-to-month tenancy.
The Tenant must vacate within 24 hours after receiving notice from the Landlord.
If the Tenant breaks the lease early, the Tenant must pay rent until a new tenant is found.
If the Tenant fails to pay rent, the Landlord may change the locks and remove the Tenant's belongings.
The Landlord must follow the legal eviction process, including a court order, to remove the Tenant.
A late fee of $25 will be charged if rent is more than five days late.
A late fee of 20% of the monthly rent will be charged for each day rent is late.
A fee of $35 applies to any returned or bounced payment.
The Tenant shall pay all of the Landlord's attorney fees in any dispute, regardless of outcome.
There is no application fee for renewing this lease.
The Tenant must pay a $500 administrative fee for every maintenance request.
Late fees will not exceed 5% of the monthly rent.
The Tenant shall pay a penalty of $100 per day for any violation of the house rules.
The Landlord shall not be liable for any injury or damage on the premises, including damage caused by the Landlord's own negligence.
The Tenant is advised to obtain renter's insurance for personal belongings.
The Tenant waives the right to a jury trial in any dispute arising from this lease.
The Landlord will maintain liability insurance for the common areas of the building.
The Tenant waives all claims against the Landlord for loss of property for any reason.
Each party is responsible for damage caused by its own negligence.
The Tenant agrees not to report any code violations to government authorities.
The Landlord will comply with all applicable building and health codes.
No pets are allowed without the Landlord's written consent.
Guests may stay up to fourteen consecutive nights without the Landlord's approval.
The Tenant may not have any overnight guests at any time.
A refundable pet deposit of $200 is required for each approved pet.
The Landlord may evict the Tenant immediately if a guest stays longer than one night.
Service animals and assistance animals are permitted regardless of the pet policy.
The Tenant must pay $50 per day for each visitor who enters the building.
Quiet hours are from 10 p.m. to 7 a.m. for all residents and guests.
